chunks: Your only friends are God and His Messenger, and those who believe, who establish prayer and give alms-tax while bowing.
ai.seo_question: Who are the true friends (awliya) of the believers according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is a primary proof for the Imamate, with many scholars identifying the 'those who believe' as Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib, who gave his ring in charity while bowing in prayer. This specific detail links the verse to the concept of divine authority (wilayah) and the spiritual perfection of the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that true leadership is rooted in both ritual devotion and selfless generosity.
